description: For one ranked agent: its independence score (1 if it paid, in 30 days, an address with demand from three or more operator sets; else half the best score of an agent outside its set that paid one of its payees, best path, at most three hops), the path, its L9 counterparty count under the published rule and under the cluster-aware rule, the inflation ratio between them, and the size of its operator set (same bound wallet, owner, minter or first funder, each link capped at 50). Definitions rank.independence.v1, rank.inflation.v1, cluster.ratio.v1.

agent.description: Agent token id, slug or bound wallet
